content: LdCom: No IPduTiming . minimumDelay defined The ISig- nal is mapped into an ISignalIPdu . Only if this ISignalIPdu does not contain an IPduTiming in iPduTimingSpecification which has IPduTiming . mini- mumDelay defined, the ISignalIPdu is sent by the EcuInstance and the LdCom module is present, this ISignal shall be handled by LdCom.
